api.consumer_compatibility: Only the checksum-bound attention-softmax boundary accepting signed-int64-container Q12.20 logits plus the authoritative valid-key bitmap is compatible. A Q6.9, score-pair, sentinel-only, or otherwise different consumer must reject this version and use a separately checksummed contract.
api.error_policy: Any malformed type, range, canonical encoding, row length, mask length, frame field, reserved field, payload length, or trailing byte rejects the complete row before output publication.

functions.canonicalize_producer_score_pair: canonicalize_producer_score_pair(pair) validates the exact bound-producer range and maps every zero mantissa, including a reachable summed head exponent, to canonical (0,0).
functions.compare_score_pairs: compare_score_pairs(left_pair, right_pair) returns exactly -1, 0, or +1 from exact represented values.
functions.normalize_score_row: normalize_score_row(score_pairs, valid_mask) canonicalizes producer zeros and returns (scores_q12_20, common_exponent, argmax_index).
functions.pack_input_row: pack_input_row(score_pairs, valid_mask) canonicalizes producer zeros and emits the canonical input frame only after validating every pair, including masked pairs.
functions.pack_normalized_row: pack_normalized_row(score_pairs, valid_mask) performs validation and normalization internally; callers cannot supply derived scores, common_exponent, or argmax_index.
functions.unpack_input_row: unpack_input_row(payload) accepts only the exact canonical input frame and returns immutable tuples.
functions.unpack_normalized_row: unpack_normalized_row(payload) accepts only the exact canonical output frame and returns immutable tuples. The valid-key bitmap remains authoritative.

api.input_types: score_pairs is an immutable tuple of immutable two-integer tuples; valid_mask is an immutable tuple of exact booleans. bool is not accepted as an integer.
api.row_atomicity: No partial row result, partial packed frame, inferred default, compatibility alias, or repaired field is permitted.

comparison.algorithm: After canonical validation, zero compares by sign class. For two nonzero pairs choose e_cmp=min(e_a,e_b), form A=m_a<<(e_a-e_cmp) and B=m_b<<(e_b-e_cmp) in signed 543-bit or wider exact integers, then compare A and B. This is exact for positive, negative, mixed-sign, unequal-exponent, and extreme pairs.
comparison.equality: Equality is represented-value equality, not field equality; for example (1,0), (2,-1), and (4,-2) compare equal.
comparison.ordering: The result is a total order over canonical score pairs. No floating-point conversion, host-libm operation, saturation, truncation, or rounded comparison is allowed.
comparison.zero: The bound producer may emit (0,e) for any summed head exponent e in -278 through 244. The direct interface canonicalizes every such pair to (0,0); canonical packed input permits only (0,0).

input.head_scale: The fixed-softmax realization applies the exact HEAD64 attention scale 1/sqrt(64)=1/8 after exact row-max centering.
input.validation_order: At the direct producer interface validate every pair including masked pairs, canonicalize any in-range zero to (0,0), and validate the complete bitmap before applying the mask semantically. Packed frames must already contain canonical (0,0) zeros and reject any alternate zero exponent.

normalization.all_masked_row: Reject before choosing a common exponent or publishing output.
normalization.argmax_tie: Choose the lowest key index among exact equal valid maxima. Every valid score equal to the maximum centers to exact zero.
normalization.common_exponent: Choose the minimum score_exponent among valid nonzero pairs. Valid canonical zeros do not participate. If every valid pair is zero, choose 0.
normalization.exact_alignment: For each valid nonzero pair, aligned_i=score_mantissa_i<<(score_exponent_i-common_exponent). A valid zero aligns to 0. Alignment is exact and uses signed 543-bit or wider integers.
normalization.mask_order: Masked pairs are validated but excluded from common-exponent selection, maximum selection, alignment, and centering. Their packed output score is assigned only after all valid numeric results are complete.
normalization.row_max: Select one global maximum across all valid keys using exact aligned integers; tile-local maxima are not sufficient.
normalization.row_max_centering: For every valid key, centered_i=aligned_i-aligned_argmax in signed 544-bit or wider arithmetic. Therefore centered_i is never positive and the selected maximum is exactly zero.
normalization.zero_after_centering: Every exact centered zero is canonical integer +0 at common_exponent; no negative-zero state exists.

objective: Freeze deterministic, exact comparison and row normalization of QK_BFP8_E16_HEAD64_V1 score pairs before the checksum-bound signed-int64-container Q12.20 attention-softmax boundary without granting workload, model, RTL, or stage execution authority.

common.mask_bit_order: key index k is byte floor(k/8), bit k mod 8; one means valid and zero means masked
common.mask_tail: Unused high bits in the final mask byte must be zero.
common.row_order: Scores and mask bits are in increasing key index with no permutation, padding between records, or trailing bytes.

input_frame.layout: bytes 0..7 ASCII QKSPIN01; bytes 8..9 u16 schema_version=2; bytes 10..11 u16 flags=0; bytes 12..13 u16 row_length; bytes 14..15 u16 record_bytes=6; then row_length records; then ceil(row_length/8) mask bytes
input_frame.record_layout: signed-int32 score_mantissa followed by signed-int16 score_exponent

output_frame.layout: bytes 0..7 ASCII QKSPOU01; bytes 8..9 u16 schema_version=2; bytes 10..11 u16 flags=0; bytes 12..13 u16 row_length; bytes 14..15 u16 score_bytes=8; bytes 16..17 signed-int16 common_exponent; bytes 18..19 u16 argmax_index; bytes 20..23 u32 reserved=0; then row_length signed-int64-container Q12.20 scores; then ceil(row_length/8) mask bytes

prohibited_actions: Load a model or run fixed inputs, inference, calibration, scoring, rank-margin evaluation, generation, or repair replay.
Create or execute a candidate, workload package, command bundle, or execution namespace.
Edit RTL, design specifications, manifests, U280 files, constraints, or pipeline stage state.
Claim RTL correctness, benchmark PASS, timing, area, coverage, quality, or stage completion from this static package.

proof_widths.aligned_score: signed 543 bits: signed-21 score_mantissa shifted left by at most 522
proof_widths.centered_score: signed 544 bits or wider for subtraction of two signed-543 aligned operands
proof_widths.common_exponent: signed 10 bits, stored in signed 16 bits
proof_widths.realization_intermediate: signed 805 bits or wider: signed-544 centered value shifted left by at most 261 when common_exponent+17 is nonnegative
proof_widths.row_length_and_argmax: unsigned 10-bit values, stored in unsigned 16 bits

realization.authoritative_binding: design/CHIP_SCOPE.json SHA-256 a5d61c40c89988a53fd3d039da48bd3de26d60f5d6d0bf5cce1e60176d4dcb2f at numerical_behavior.attention_softmax.logit_format_after_scale = signed_int64_container_for_Q12_20; its Q6.9 materialized-score path is historical and rejected.
realization.guard_round_sticky: For a right shift s>0, round the nonnegative magnitude. guard is discarded bit s-1; round is bit s-2 or zero when absent; sticky is OR of lower discarded bits; increment the retained magnitude iff guard and (round or sticky or retained_lsb). Restore the original sign afterward.
realization.masked_output: After valid entries are realized, every masked packed slot is deterministic zero filler. The bitmap is authoritative and the checksum-bound attention-softmax consumer must suppress masked keys before recurrence or lookup.
realization.negative_overflow: A valid rounded result below signed-int64 minimum deterministically saturates to -9223372036854775808, preserving a legal Q12.20 container value.
realization.positive_overflow: A positive centered or realized valid result is an internal contract violation and rejects the row; it is never clamped to zero.
realization.rounding_boundary: This Q12.20 realization is the sole rounding boundary. Alignment, comparison, maximum selection, and centering are exact.
realization.underflow_and_zero: A magnitude below one-half output LSB rounds to +0; an exact half with even retained zero also rounds to +0. Post-round zero is canonical integer +0.
